events.text: Mika Mármol (Feyenoord) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half begins Real Betis 0, Feyenoord 0.
Delay in match because of an injury Jeremiah St. Juste (Feyenoord).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Charles Vanhoutte (Feyenoord) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Real Betis 1, Feyenoord 0. Isco (Real Betis) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom right corner.
